mapper.insert: INSERT INTO nw_knowledge_storage_budgets(tenant_id) VALUES(#{tenantId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id FROM nw_knowledge_storage_budgets WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} FOR UPDATE

WITH bodies AS ( SELECT coalesce(sum(octet_length(content)),0)::bigint AS bytes, coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(content)),0)::bigint AS physical, 0::bigint AS chunks FROM nw_knowledge_document_contents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT coalesce(sum(octet_length(content)),0)::bigint, coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(content)),0)::bigint, count(*)::bigint FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_contents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ), vectors AS ( SELECT coalesce(sum(dimensions::bigint*4),0)::bigint AS bytes, coalesce(sum(pg_column_size(embedding)),0)::bigint AS physical, count(*)::bigint AS total FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_embeddings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ) SELECT (SELECT sum(bytes)::bigint FROM bodies) AS content_bytes, v.bytes AS embedding_bytes, (SELECT sum(chunks)::bigint FROM bodies) AS chunk_bodies, v.total AS embeddings, (v.physical+(SELECT sum(physical) FROM bodies))::bigint AS physical_bytes, b.max_content_bytes, b.max_chunk_bodies, (SELECT count(*) FROM nw_knowledge_document_versions WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}) AS source_versions, (SELECT count(*) FROM nw_knowledge_chunks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}) AS chunk_references, (SELECT count(*) FROM nw_runtime_knowledge_chunks WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}::text) AS frozen_references, (SELECT count(*) FROM nw_knowledge_rebuild_batch_embeddings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}) AS rebuild_references, (SELECT count(*) FROM nw_knowledge_index_projection_holds WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}) AS index_projection_holds, (SELECT count(*) FROM nw_knowledge_index_cleanup_intents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId}) AS index_cleanup_intents FROM vectors v LEFT JOIN nw_knowledge_storage_budgets b ON b.tenant_id=#{tenantId}
SELECT id FROM nw_knowledge_document_contents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND digest=#{digest} AND content=#{content} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT content FROM nw_knowledge_document_contents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_contents WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND document_id=#{documentId} AND digest=#{digest} AND content=#{content} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT id FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_embeddings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND content_id=#{contentId} AND model_id=#{modelId} AND model_revision=#{revision} AND dimensions=#{dimensions} AND digest=encode(sha256(convert_to(CAST(#{vector} AS vector)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') AND embedding=CAST(#{vector} AS vector) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT embedding_id FROM nw_knowledge_rebuild_batch_embeddings WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND batch_id=#{batchId} ORDER BY position
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_knowledge_rebuild_batch_embeddings e USING nw_knowledge_rebuild_batches b,nw_knowledge_rebuild_jobs j WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND e.batch_id=b.id AND b.job_id=j.id AND j.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND j.id=#{jobId} AND j.status='PUBLISHED'
mapper.sql: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_documents d WHERE d.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND d.id=v.document_id AND d.current_source_version=v.source_version) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_base_revisions r WHERE r.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND r.kb_id=v.kb_id AND jsonb_exists(r.source_versions,v.source_version)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_runtime_knowledge_sources s WHERE s.tenant_id=v.tenant_id::text AND s.source_id=v.kb_id::text AND s.source_version=v.source_version) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_rebuild_items i WHERE i.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND i.document_id=v.document_id AND (i.source_version=v.source_version OR i.target_source_version=v.source_version)) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_index_projection_holds h WHERE h.tenant_id=v.tenant_id AND h.kb_id=v.kb_id AND h.source_version=v.source_version)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM nw_knowledge_document_versions v WHERE v.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND v.id=#{id} AND

DELETE FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_sets s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.id IN (SELECT x.id FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_sets x WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND x.kb_id=#{kbId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_document_versions v WHERE v.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND v.chunk_set_id=x.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_chunks c JOIN nw_runtime_knowledge_chunks r ON r.source_tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND r.chunk_id=c.id::text WHERE c.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND c.chunk_set_id=x.id) ORDER BY x.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF x SKIP LOCKED)

DELETE FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_embeddings e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.id IN (SELECT x.id FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_embeddings x WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_contents b JOIN nw_knowledge_documents d ON d.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND d.id=b.document_id WHERE b.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND b.id=x.content_id AND d.kb_id=#{kbId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_chunks c WHERE c.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND c.embedding_id=x.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_rebuild_batch_embeddings b WHERE b.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND b.embedding_id=x.id) ORDER BY x.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF x SKIP LOCKED)

DELETE FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_contents c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id IN (SELECT x.id FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_contents x WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_documents d WHERE d.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND d.id=x.document_id AND d.kb_id=#{kbId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_chunks r WHERE r.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND r.content_id=x.id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_chunk_embeddings e WHERE e.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND e.content_id=x.id) ORDER BY x.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF x SKIP LOCKED)

DELETE FROM nw_knowledge_document_contents c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id IN (SELECT x.id FROM nw_knowledge_document_contents x WHERE x.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_documents d WHERE d.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND d.id=x.document_id AND d.kb_id=#{kbId}) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nw_knowledge_document_versions v WHERE v.tenant_id=x.tenant_id AND v.content_id=x.id) ORDER BY x.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE OF x SKIP LOCKED)
